2609.34314.title: PlaylistEval: Can Video-Language Judges Be Trusted at Day Scale and Beyond?
2609.34314.paper_summary: Video-language models are increasingly used as judges of video understanding, both for evaluating model outputs and for training reward models. Whether their judgments remain reliable when the evidence is buried in day-long videos has yet to be established. Existing benchmarks cannot answer this. Their videos are typically only a few minutes long, many answer pairs can be separated from the transcript alone, and collecting human judgments does not scale to ultra-long videos. We introduce PlaylistEval, an agentic framework that builds video-language judge benchmarks over 100-hour playlist collection without human annotation. It automatically generates questions with paired answers whose differences are controlled by causal degradation, so that every pair demands retrieval across the collection. The resulting benchmark contains 630 pairs across seven domains spanning both static and dynamic knowledge, and on a stratified subset of 152 pairs it agrees with human judgments 93.0% of the time (IAA 0.781). Evaluating 17 omnimodal and multimodal models from eight families reveals that frontier judges reach only 75.4% pairwise accuracy, while open-source judge models perform far behind. We further show that both retrieval and final judgment depend on using multiple modalities, and that judge accuracy degrades as the playlist set grows. We release our pipeline, benchmark, and evaluation code at https://playlisteval.github.io.
2609.34314.paper_summary_zh: 視頻語言模型越來越多地被用作視頻理解的評判者，無論是用於評估模型輸出還是訓練獎勵模型。當證據埋藏在長達一天的視頻中時，它們的判斷是否仍然可靠尚未確立。現有的基準無法回答這個問題。它們的視頻通常只有幾分鐘長，許多答案對可以僅從文字稿中分離出來，並且收集人類判斷無法擴展到超長視頻。我們介紹了PlaylistEval，一個自主框架，該框架在不需要人類註釋的情況下，基於100小時的播放列表集合構建視頻語言評判基準。它自動生成問題及其配對答案，這些答案的差異由因果降解控制，因此每對都需要在集合中檢索。最終的基準包含630對跨越七個領域的配對，涵蓋靜態和動態知識，並且在152對的分層子集中，它與人類判斷的一致性達到93.0%（IAA 0.781）。對來自八個家族的17個全模態和多模態模型的評估顯示，前沿評判者的成對準確率僅達到75.4%，而開源評判模型的表現遠遠落後。我們進一步顯示，檢索和最終判斷都依賴於使用多種模態，並且隨著播放列表集合的增長，評判的準確性會下降。我們在 https://playlisteval.github.io 上發布了我們的管道、基準和評估代碼。
